title: Power Apps: form fill assistance adds lookup, rich text and multi-select choice fields
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned field-type expansion from the currently documented feature and its licensing and controls. The app-designer route needs only the omitted more-options button; this is a minor correction. Prior verification directions were treated as history, not evidence.
